content: Apple AVCaptureSession startRunning is synchronous and should run on a serial queue off main. Authorization is checked before configuration; requestAccess prompts once, subsequent changes use Settings. Project inference: keep dedicated session queue separate from frame analysis, expose explicit authorized/denied/restricted states and observed running/error state. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avcapturesession https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avcapturedevice/requestaccess(for:completionhandler:) https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/uiapplication/opensettingsurlstring . Current AVCam sample requires iOS26 and must not be adopted wholesale for iOS18.5.
